signature.one_line: Podcast trailer: money-claim hook with punch-ins, white lead + bold accent Title-Case numbers staggered left, black-frame chapter breaks, pill captions on screens.
unique_devices: Two-tier staggered caption: white Poppins-500 lead line with wide word gaps + bold accent Title-Case key line(s), every number and money amount always key, second key line indented ~11 % W
Caption system switches to small white text in a dark rounded pill at ~80 % H over screen recordings, B-roll and black frames
15-40-frame pure-black frames with audio continuing (J-cut) as chapter breaks
Punch-in (~115-130 %) or angle switch every ~38-75 frames in the hook, shot / reverse-shot every 25-40 frames in the climax
signature.why_it_works: A checkable money claim with every number in accent hooks in seconds; black-frame breaks reset attention between the hook, the social-proof montage and the episode, and the open-loop payoff sells the full episode.

hook.type: bold claim / contrarian money claim with maths
hook.first_frame: guest medium close-up at a podcast desk with warm amber practical lamps, mic in the foreground; 2-line caption on the chest with the money words in bold accent; sponsor bug bottom-right

structure.what: money claim + simple checkable maths, numbers in accent; punch-ins / angle switches every ~38-75 frames
host reaction, then a black frame with audio over announcing a part two
social proof montage: screen recordings of the previous episode and comments asking for more, laptop / TV B-roll, black countdown frame
host resets the context and asks the question
guest's bold restatement of the thesis
fast shot / reverse-shot with stacked numbers as accent callouts
promise of a game-changing method without revealing it (open loop)
solid-colour collab end card: show logo x partner

pacing.notes: front-loaded hook and fast tail; the middle montage relaxes (long screen holds); 42 % soft cuts; pauses mostly in the montage

captions.what: white lead line + accent Title-Case key line(s), staggered left
captions.how: lead Poppins 500 83 px, word-spacing +0.3em; key Poppins 700 122 px #F8FF0D; block left edge x 7-22 %, centre y 61-73 %, key line pitch ~5.9 % H, 2nd key line indented ~11 % W; hard cut per word 2-3 frames early; block re-placed on angle changes
Poppins 500 47 px white in a near-black rounded pill (r ~18 px), centred at y ~80 %

background_text.how: 'POWERED BY' small caps + partner wordmark, bottom-right x 50-90 %, y ~89 %

broll_inserts.what: screen recordings of a previous video, its description and comments
broll_inserts.how: full-screen UI with slow screen zoom / scroll; keep to under ~250 frames for a standalone reel

broll_inserts.what: handheld B-roll of the video playing on a laptop / office TV

camera.how: ~115-130 % crop or switch to side angle every ~38-75 frames, hard or soft cut

transitions.how: 15-40 frames of pure black, J-cut audio continues, pill caption on black
alternate speaker and listener every 25-40 frames

end_card.how: solid mauve-card colour, white show logo / 'x' / partner wordmark stacked centred

case.lead: sentence case as spoken (first word capitalised)
case.key: Title Case on the key word(s) (e.g. 'Key Word', 'Big Number')

captions_spec.punctuation: mostly dropped; currency sign and thousands comma kept in money, '?' kept on questions

grouping.key_words_per_caption: 0-2 (numbers, money and the claim word are always key)
grouping.sync: word-by-word: each word appears on its spoken word; the key line appears on its word
grouping.break: new caption at each phrase; previous caption hard-cuts out, often with 1-2 empty frames between

block.left_pct_of_W: 7-22 (varies per shot, keeps the block on the chest beside the mic)

layout.stagger: a second key line is indented ~11 % W to the right of the first (e.g. line 1 at x 22 %, line 2 at x 33 %)

lead_line.example: a 4-word lead line at x ~22-70 %, centre y 61.3 %

key_line.example: key line 1 centre y 67.0 %, key line 2 centre y 72.9 % (line pitch ~5.9 % H)

lead.letterform_evidence: single-storey a, round o/e, Poppins' flat-topped t and straight-tailed y, single-storey g with open tail
lead.calibration_note: single words measured over a dark shirt (clean). A 4-word line = 4.14 % H, 48.2 % W: the original sets WIDE word gaps (~0.63 em), so match single words, then add word-spacing
lead.shadow: soft dark drop shadow, e.g. 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5) (estimated)
lead.word_spacing: +0.3em over the font's normal space (measured gap between words ~0.63 em)

key.letterform_evidence: same Poppins shapes as the lead, heavier stroke (SemiBold-Bold); M with vertical sides, round i dots
key.calibration_note: a 7-letter Title Case key word measured ink 4.84 % H, 40.1 % W (another, with i-dots, 5.23 % H, 37.4 % W); compute expected ink for the user's key word with fit_font.py at 122 px
key.shadow: same soft drop shadow as lead (estimated)
key.selection_rule: every number / money amount and the one word or short phrase that carries the claim

pill.used_for: captions over screen recordings, B-roll and black frames
pill.box: rounded rectangle hugging the text: near-black (~rgba(20,20,20,.9), estimated), radius ~18 px at 1080 (estimated), padding ~4 % W left/right and ~2 % H top/bottom; a 3-word pill spans x ~27-72.5 %, y 76.7-83.8 %

animation.lead_entry: hard cut per word (full opacity in 1 frame, no scale, no slide), 2-3 frames BEFORE the spoken word start
animation.key_entry: hard cut, no pop/scale, ~3 frames before the word
animation.exit: hard cut; often 1-2 empty frames before the next caption
animation.position_on_cut: when the camera angle changes the next caption block is re-placed for the new framing (e.g. y 60 % -> 66 %)

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames (25 fps); font names closest matches (unverified); items marked estimated were not isolated.

other_text_spec.text: 'POWERED BY' small white caps (~1.3 % H) + sponsor wordmark (~4 % H) bottom-right, x 50-90 %, centre y ~89 %
real recordings of the previous episode's video player, description and comment section (not designed text), with pill captions over them
pure black with only the pill caption and the sponsor bug; audio continues (J-cut)
white line-art show logo (~20 % W) at ~33 % H, white 'x' at ~50 % H, white partner wordmark (~25 % W) at ~65 % H, all centred

style.look_intent: high-contrast, natural-saturation, warm: amber practical lamps, dark background, natural skin

sound.music: music bed likely (gap level -6 dB vs speech), fills the montage gaps
sfx: hits / whooshes on some hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.36)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Emphasis-Word Zoom
catalog_styles.role: yellow Title-Case numbers and claim words

use_when: a podcast clip or trailer for a longer episode
the speaker makes money / number claims that should pop
Hinglish or English two-person conversation with multi-cam footage

brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B03 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B03.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: the {{ACCENT}} key line must stay >= 3:1 on the footage (a light, high-luminance accent works best on dark sets); white pill text >= 7:1 on its box)
- {{TEXT}} lead captions + pill text - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} key words / every number and money amount - default yellow #F8FF0D
- {{ACCENT_2}} - none
- {{SURFACE}} black chapter frames + pill box - default #000000 (pill ~rgba(20,20,20,.9))
- {{CARD_BG}} end card - default mauve-purple #6F4465
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} key line - default Poppins 700
- {{FONT_BODY}} lead line + pill - default Poppins 500
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle (optional on the end card)
- {{LOGO}} - show logo on the end card; partner wordmark for the sponsor bug if any

Canvas 1080x1920, 25 fps.

EDIT
1. Hook (first ~17 %): the biggest money / number claim with checkable maths; first word within frame 1; punch-in (~115-130 %) or angle switch every ~38-75 frames.
2. Chapter breaks: 15-40 frames of pure {{SURFACE}} with audio continuing (J-cut) and only a pill caption on it.
3. Social proof (optional, keep under ~250 frames standalone): screen recordings of a previous video and its comments, laptop / TV B-roll, slow screen zoom/scroll.
4. Climax: shot / reverse-shot every 25-40 frames with numbers stacked as {{ACCENT}} callouts; end on an open-loop promise.
5. End card (~45 frames): solid {{CARD_BG}}, white {{LOGO}} (~20 % W) at ~33 % H, white 'x' at ~50 %, partner wordmark (~25 % W) at ~65 %, centred.
6. Sponsor bug (if any): 'POWERED BY' small white caps (~1.3 % H) + partner wordmark (~4 % H), bottom-right x 50-90 %, centre y ~89 %, throughout.

CAPTIONS
7. Latin script (Roman Hinglish where speech is Hindi); lead sentence case, key words Title Case; drop most punctuation, keep currency signs, thousands commas and '?'.
8. Lead line: 1-4 words, {{FONT_BODY}} 83 px, {{TEXT}}, word-spacing +0.3em (wide gaps), soft shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5), no box.
9. Key line(s): every number / money amount and the claim word, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 122 px, {{ACCENT}}, same shadow; key line 1 centre ~67 %, key line 2 centre ~72.9 % (pitch ~5.9 % H) indented ~11 % W right of line 1.
10. Block: left-aligned, left edge x 7-22 % (keep it on the chest beside the mic), centre y 61-73 %, band y 58-76 %, max width 75 %; re-place the block when the camera angle changes.
11. Timing: every word hard-cuts on (1 frame, no scale/slide) 2-3 frames BEFORE it is spoken; the block hard-cuts out with 1-2 empty frames before the next.
12. Over screens, B-roll and black frames switch to pill captions: {{FONT_BODY}} 47 px {{TEXT}} in a near-black rounded pill (r ~18 px, padding ~4 % W / ~2 % H), centred at y ~80 %.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, natural-saturation, warm amber practicals on a dark background, natural skin.
SOUND: voice at about -14 LUFS over a bed that fills the montage; hits/whooshes on some hard cuts; bleep expletives.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Poppins; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames over a dark area: "To" and "get" ({{FONT_BODY}} 83 px), "KEY WORD" ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 122 px {{ACCENT}}), and "walk you through" in the pill (47 px).
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.05,0.58,0.95,0.76 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60,{{ACCENT}}:80" (tighten --box per word); --box 0.25,0.76,0.75,0.84 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" (pill).
c) Required: "To" ink 3.59 % +-0.5 of H and 8.8 % +-2 of W; "get" 3.44 % +-0.5 and 12.1 % +-2; "walk you through" 2.5 % +-0.5 and 37.6 % +-2. For the key line compute expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<{{FONT_DISPLAY}}>" --word "KEY WORD" at 122 px (a 7-letter key word targets ~4.8 % H).
